title: Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Control under Regime-Switching Demand: A Controlled Comparison of LSTM, MLP, and (s,S) Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.15945v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classical inventory policies such as (s,S) are provably optimal under stationary demand but cannot adapt when demand switches between hidden regimes, and memoryless deep reinforcement learning policies, confined to a fixed observation window, cannot maintain a belief over latent demand structure. We ask whether a recurrent policy offers a measurable advantage over both a memoryless policy and a classical baseline under regime-switching demand, and how that advantage scales with supply-chain lead time. We build a custom Gymnasium environment in which daily demand is generated by a two-state hidden Markov process with Poisson emissions, so that the regime is known at evaluation time but hidden from the agent. translated_title: 区制转换需求下的库存控制强化学习：LSTM、MLP 与 (s,S) 策略的受控比较
translated_abstract: 经典库存策略（如 (s,S) 策略）在平稳需求下可证明是最优的，但当需求在隐藏的区制之间切换时便无法自适应；而受限于固定观测窗口的无记忆深度强化学习策略，则无法对潜在的需求结构维持信念状态。我们探究的问题是：在区制转换需求下，循环策略相比无记忆策略和经典基线是否具有可测量的优势，以及该优势如何随供应链提前期而变化。我们构建了一个定制的 Gymnasium 环境，其中每日需求由具有泊松发射的两状态隐马尔可夫过程生成，因此区制在评估阶段是已知的，但对智能体是隐藏的。优化后的 (s,S) 启发式策略、MLP PPO 智能体和 LSTM 循环 PPO 智能体在相同计算资源下训练，并在 0、3、6 和 10 天的提前期下各进行 30 个确定性回合的评估。该循环策略优于……
tldr: 在需求由隐马尔可夫过程切换区制的环境中，LSTM 循环 PPO 策略相比无记忆的 MLP 策略和经典 (s,S) 基线展现出可测量的性能优势，且该优势随供应链提前期的延长而扩大。
